items.title: Bounded concurrency gate
items.context: An owner-approved race test with monitoring and rollback
items.intended_use: Document the cap before using synchronized delivery
items.payload: REVIEW-ONLY: fresh resource, 2-3 synchronized requests maximum
caveats: Never flood or reuse a production resource
items.safety: Authorized testing only. Use designated identities, synthetic data, the least-impacting proof, and stop on unexpected effects.
